title: John Healey ‘targets tax crackdown on online marketplaces’ in first budget - The Guardian

entries.title: Business tour of JobTarget in New London (5526210019).jpg
entries.description: Governor Malloy went on a business tour of JobTarget, a local company in New London founded 10 years ago that specializes in job boards for professional organizations and some trade publications. The business, which currently employs about 70 people, helps streamline the process of improving online job posting technology and streamlining hires. The visit gave Governor Malloy the opportunity to speak with the company's CEO and founder, Andrew Banever, and with the staff to discuss issues of concern to businesses like his. March 14, 2011
entries.creator: Dannel Malloy
